snippet.title: The Looter - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at The Looter in this latest trailer for the upcoming survival horror looter shooter game. The post-apocalyptic land of Tortura is a decaying world of overgrown ruins that devoured the last traces of humanity. In The Looter, a lone scavenger navigates its depths, facing mutated animals, vile abominations, and dangerous strangers. Uncovering hidden secrets is key to survival. The Looter will be available ion PC in 2026.
